description: This file defines the static class 'XStringFormats' which provides various predefined text layout configurations using 'XStringFormat' objects for use in PDF drawing operations within the PdfSharp library.

classes.name: XStringFormats
classes.description: Provides static properties for commonly used text layout formats as 'XStringFormat' objects with specific alignment configurations.

methods.name: Default
methods.description: Returns the default text layout format, which aligns text left on the baseline.

methods.name: BaseLineLeft
methods.description: Returns a format that aligns text to the left on the baseline.

methods.name: TopLeft
methods.description: Returns a format that aligns text to the top left of the layout rectangle.

methods.name: CenterLeft
methods.description: Returns a format that aligns text to the center left of the layout rectangle.

methods.name: BottomLeft
methods.description: Returns a format that aligns text to the bottom left of the layout rectangle.

methods.name: BaseLineCenter
methods.description: Returns a format that centers the text on the baseline.

methods.name: TopCenter
methods.description: Returns a format that aligns text at the top center of the layout rectangle.

methods.name: Center
methods.description: Returns a format that centers the text both horizontally and vertically.

methods.name: BottomCenter
methods.description: Returns a format that aligns text at the bottom center of the layout rectangle.

methods.name: BaseLineRight
methods.description: Returns a format that aligns text to the right on the baseline.

methods.name: TopRight
methods.description: Returns a format that aligns text to the top right of the layout rectangle.

methods.name: CenterRight
methods.description: Returns a format that aligns text to the center right of the layout rectangle.

methods.name: BottomRight
methods.description: Returns a format that aligns text to the bottom right of the layout rectangle.
